jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: KING CORE BODY three-view character-model design sheet, landscape 3:2 canvas, clean light warm-white background.
Input image 1 = APPROVED King's CORE BODY reference, authority for all BODY armor, colors, proportions and identity below the neck. Image 2 = latest APPROVED NORMAL HEAD with crimson sagittal dorsal fin, authority for head/horns and normal face. These are reference images for a NEW turnaround sheet, not permission to redesign.
Draw exactly THREE complete full-body orthographic-style views of this SAME robot, ordered FRONT, LEFT PROFILE facing screen-left, REAR, in separate evenly spaced columns. Same body scale and common floor line, matching skull, shoulder, hip, knee and ankle heights across views. Standing naturally upright, feet shoulder-width, arms relaxed slightly away from torso with a small elbow bend, same physical pose seen from three sides. No perspective foreshortening, no 3/4 view, no action pose. Frame complete horn tips, both hands and full soles with outer margins.
King identity: navy blue torso and armor, ivory limbs, crimson abdomen/panels and chin, gold outlines and circular joints. Large navy shoulder plates with ivory/gold edging and red outer recesses; paired gold rectangular CHEST LOUVRES and the central golden champion crest belong on the FRONT ONLY; navy back armor with a simple central spine, two discreet empty backpack attachment sockets and gold-edged structural plating, no invented giant backpack. Strong heavy forearms, both normal dark articulated hands, long ivory thighs, ivory knee/shin planes with navy side panels and gold accents, broad navy boots with gold toe caps and red/gold ankle circles. Preserve the exact reference body's anatomical proportions and long-legged hero presence; don't make it squat or stretch only the shins. Rear knees/heel joints reveal coherent simple dark mechanics and gold socket rims, not a copy of front kneecaps or chest.
Use the APPROVED NORMAL FACE in every visible face view: separate pale eyes, navy nose, broad ivory lower face with subtle mouth line, crimson chin latch, gold cheek frames and circular gold ear housings. Head shell must keep its tall normal volume. Exactly FIVE gold crown pieces: one thick center horn smoothly curving forward and UP, tiny backward notch; two long inner slim fins, two shorter outer fins. Add the SAME single thin crimson MIDLINE fore-aft dorsal fin behind the gold crown: broad red triangular face in left PROFILE, completely hidden by the taller front gold horn in FRONT, narrow red EDGE only at REAR. No broad red triangle in rear/front, no second red fin. Rear view cannot show a face or mouthplate. Crown roots remain frontal/temporal, no extra gold spikes.
This is the UNARMORED CORE VARIANT: no wings, no shoulder cannons, no drill or shield, no missile pods, no auxiliary booster nacelles. Both hands remain present.
Style: clean crisp Japanese cel robot design, controlled line hierarchy, broad clear panels and hard two-tone shadows, same drawing language as references. Add only thin faint horizontal registration lines behind the three figures. No labels, no lettering, no logos other than the existing chest emblem, no text, no arrows, no cropped figures, no new weapons.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: KING HEAD six-view detail sheet for two face states, clean light warm-white background, landscape 3:2 canvas.
Input image 1 = APPROVED NORMAL FACE with red midline helmet fin. Image 2 = APPROVED BATTLE MASK with exactly the SAME helmet and fin. Use these exact designs without redesigning the crown, skull or face.
Draw SIX equally sized head-and-short-neck views in TWO ROWS of THREE. Top row: NORMAL face FRONT, LEFT PROFILE facing screen-left, REAR. Bottom row: BATTLE MASK FRONT, LEFT PROFILE facing screen-left, REAR. Identical skull size, height, eye-line, neck baseline, crown root positions and viewing angles. The two REAR views must be IDENTICAL HELMET DESIGN because closing a mouthplate doesn't change the helmet back. Match complete horn tips and collars with generous spacing, no 3/4 views, no perspective.
Copy approved head identity: navy faceted dome with normal tall shell volume, separate pale warm eyes beneath black brow, navy nose, ivory angular lower face and heavy jaw, red chin, gold cheek vent frames and round gold ear housings.
Copy crown topology, not a similar generic crown: exactly FIVE gold pieces, central thick-rooted forward/up curved blade horn with tiny backward notch, paired long inner slim gold fins, paired shorter outer gold fins. Front projection is exactly symmetric and centered, side projection shows the curve in the forward/up plane. No flattening skull or inventing extra fins.
CRIMSON DORSAL FIN: exactly one thin vertical plate on the helmet sagittal midline, behind the forehead crown, a streamlined red triangular side face with rearward peak matching both references. FRONT: entirely occluded by the higher, broader central gold horn. LEFT PROFILE: broad crimson triangle seated along the navy dome as in references. REAR: fin is EDGE-ON so only a narrow red midline strip is visible, not a broad triangular red sail or twin crests. Keep the same fin size and pose in both rows.
Top normal face = visible navy nose, ivory mouth/jaw with subtle mouth line. Bottom battle face = the EXACT approved pair of broad ivory faceted armor halves closing over nose/mouth, central vertical seam/ridge, navy inset side vents, thin gold/blue framing, small red chin latch exposed. Eyes, brow, cheek frames, ear housings and helmet don't change.
Rear shell is a simple navy faceted armored back-of-head with subtle central panel seams and coherent ear backs; NO face or mouthplate drawn on rear. Keep gold fin direction and roots consistent rather than mirroring the entire face onto rear.
Clean cel linework, broad armor planes, hard two-tone shadows, matching source style. Thin faint horizontal eye-line/collar registration guides optional. No titles, no letters, no captions, no arrows, no new body, no shoulder gear.
